calls.title: Jeff : Jen
calls.summary: The team convened to address the cleanup and standardization of renewal data in HubSpot to improve the accuracy of board reporting. Manual data cleanup is needed due to limited access to Stripe, with Jennifer and Carrie being primary points of contact for payment history reviews. Complex enterprise renewals, such as downgrades and mid-term seat additions, require detailed documentation and calculations for renewed accuracy. Jeff proposed handling monthly renewals through semi-annual entries to manage complexity efficiently. The urgency for clean data arises from an upcoming board meeting, emphasizing the need for formal tracking of annual recurring revenue (ARR) within HubSpot to support transparent executive decision-making and enhance future reporting.
calls.keywords: Renewals, HubSpot, Stripe, Multi-year Contracts, Monthly Downgrades, Pro-rata Expansions
calls.action_items:
**Jeff Ignacio**
Review HubSpot deals and flag those with missing renewal or expansion data to Jennifer for validation (15:53)
Build reporting for NRR and renewal data, cleaning up records before presenting to Ryan for board reporting (02:08)
Create renewal opportunities in HubSpot for multi-year deals, including pro-rata expansions and closing deals as renewals occur (09:49)
Establish six-month forecasted monthly renewal deals for downgraded customers, and adjust with debooking entries if cancellations occur before forecast end (32:42)
Send Jennifer asynchronous questions related to specific deals requiring Stripe data review to confirm renewal terms and contract years (40:18)

**Jennifer Pham-Le**
Provide Jeff with Stripe payment history details upon request and help filter Stripe data by invoice amount to identify enterprise customers (00:24)
Assist with clarifications on specific multi-year and monthly renewal contracts and help validate data asynchronously (39:01)
Confirm and support correct HubSpot applications for complex order forms, including renewals, downgrades, and seat additions (04:28)
